name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C1-hand-over-from-any-giver
old:
WHERE provenance IN (${m}) AND handed_to IS NOT (CASE WHEN owner = ?1 THEN NULL ELSE ?1 END)
        AND COALESCE(handed_to, owner) = COALESCE(?2, (SELECT u.player FROM item_uids u WHERE u.uid = products.provenance AND u.state = 'escrow'))`,
new: WHERE provenance IN (${m}) AND handed_to IS NOT (CASE WHEN owner = ?1 THEN NULL ELSE ?1 END)`,
note: the batch's law: any giver hands the craft's record on - the seller that kept a sold piece names its accomplice the record, and the buyer holds the copy

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C1-escrow-giver-unread
old: AND COALESCE(handed_to, owner) = COALESCE(?2, (SELECT u.player FROM item_uids u WHERE u.uid = products.provenance AND u.state = 'escrow'))`,
note: a collect reads no giver off the escrow row - the record's own listing hands its buyer nothing

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C1-trade-second-side-no-giver
note: the trade's second half receives with no giver named - its record's hand-over is lost (the giver's row is let go before it)

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C1-trade-first-side-no-giver
note: the trade's first half receives with no giver named - the report's own trade hands nothing on

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C2-every-excuse-ended
note: the batch's law: a clean checkpoint ends a piece's excuse too - put away and taken back, it holds and strikes again

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C4-row-unsaid

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C4-strip-unsaid

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C5-cut-unmarked
old:
const cutOf = (/** @type {string} */ s, /** @type {number} */ n) =>
  s.length > n ? `${s.slice(0, n)}${LAW_VALUES_CUT}` : s;
new: const cutOf = (/** @type {string} */ s, /** @type {number} */ n) => s.slice(0, n);
note: the values cut silently - a state past the cut is excused whatever stands past it

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-C5-mark-unread
note: an excuse names a cut state - nine quadrillion passes behind eighty bank accounts
